profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Full Stack Python Developer | Backend & Data Engineering | AI/ML & Gen AI | Cloud & DevOps (AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform) | Django, FastAPI, Kafka, Snowflake, LangChain
profile.summary:
👨‍💻 Senior Software Engineer | Full Stack | AI/ML | Cloud & DevOps

Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building cloud-native, data-driven, and AI-powered enterprise platforms across Hospitality, Financial Services, Healthcare, Networking, and Telecom domains.

I specialize in scalable microservices architectures, real-time data platforms, and Generative AI solutions, delivering production-grade systems that support high-volume enterprise workloads and intelligent automation.

💡 Core Strengths

Backend & APIs: Python (Django, FastAPI, Flask), Node.js, .NET Core, REST, GraphQL, gRPC, Microservices, OAuth2/JWT, RBAC

Frontend: React.js, Vue.js, Next.js, Angular, TypeScript, Redux, D3.js, Plotly, Highcharts, Recharts

Data Engineering: Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, PySpark, Kafka, Kinesis, Spark Streaming, ETL/ELT, Snowflake, Redshift

Cloud & DevOps: AWS (Lambda, EKS, ECS, EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift, Kinesis)
Terraform, AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI)

AI / ML & GenAI: PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy
LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, RAG Pipelines, Vector Databases (FAISS, Pinecone), Prompt Engineering

Observability: CloudWatch, Prometheus & Grafana, New Relic, Distributed Tracing, SLA Monitoring

🚀 Key Achievements

• Best Western Hotel Group: Built AI-powered guest experience and personalization platforms using LLMs, RAG pipelines, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, and LangChain, enabling intelligent guest support and automated concierge systems.

• Fitch Ratings: Developed credit risk analytics platforms and AI-powered research assistants using FastAPI, Kafka, Airflow, and ML models to support financial risk analysis and ratings workflows.

• Clarion Technologies: Delivered HIPAA-compliant healthcare platforms with microservices, asynchronous pipelines, and AI-assisted document processing for patient data and claims automation.

• Technovibe Solutions: Engineered event-driven microservices and real-time data pipelines using Kafka, Airflow, and AWS, deployed on Kubernetes with IAC using Terraform.

📩 Open to Roles
Senior Software Engineer | Python Full Stack | Backend | AI/ML | Data Engineering | Cloud & DevOps

📧 Contact: hardikpatel21890@gmail.com

#PythonDeveloper #FullStackEngineer #BackendEngineer #AIEngineer #DataEngineer
#GenAI #CloudEngineer #DevOpsEngineer #AWS #Kubernetes #Terraform #OpenToWork

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Leading the development of a cloud-native property operations and guest experience platform, enabling seamless management of reservations, loyalty programs, housekeeping, pricing, and guest engagement across distributed hotel ecosystems.

- Architected and implemented scalable microservices using Python (Django, FastAPI) and Node.js, designing secure RESTful and GraphQL APIs with OAuth2, JWT, and RBAC to support integrations with mobile apps, POS systems, and third-party booking platforms.

- Built real-time and batch data pipelines using Apache Airflow, AWS Glue, PySpark, Kafka, and Kinesis to process reservation data, payment events, and IoT telemetry, enabling advanced analytics and forecasting.

- Developed LLM-powered personalization and guest support systems using OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, and vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone), implementing RAG pipelines for contextual recommendations, semantic search, and automated concierge services.

- Designed agentic AI workflows orchestrating booking logic, pricing intelligence, and customer interactions, enabling intelligent and autonomous guest engagement.

- Deployed and managed applications on AWS (EKS, Lambda, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Redshift) using Terraform and AWS CDK, ensuring secure, scalable, and highly available infrastructure.

- Implemented event-driven architecture using Kafka and SNS/SQS, optimized performance with Redis caching and Elasticsearch, and ensured reliability through CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and observability using CloudWatch, Prometheus, and Grafana.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and enhanced a credit risk analytics and ratings platform, enabling analysts to evaluate structured finance instruments, issuer risk, and market trends through scalable microservices architecture.

- Designed secure APIs using FastAPI and Django REST Framework with OAuth2/JWT, supporting high-volume integrations across analytics systems and compliance platforms.

- Built real-time data pipelines using Apache Airflow, PySpark, Kafka, AWS Glue, and Kinesis to process financial statements, market feeds, and regulatory data for downstream analytics.

- Developed interactive dashboards and visualizations using React, Vue, and Plotly to provide insights into risk metrics, stress scenarios, and exposure distributions.

- Implemented machine learning models for default probability estimation, anomaly detection, and predictive risk analysis using Scikit-learn and PyTorch.

- Built LLM-powered research assistants and RAG pipelines using OpenAI, LangChain, and vector databases to summarize financial documents and extract key insights for analysts.

- Deployed microservices on AWS using EKS, Lambda, and Redshift with Terraform-based infrastructure, improving scalability, performance, and system reliability.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered secure healthcare data platforms for managing patient records, claims processing, and clinical workflows, ensuring compliance with healthcare data standards.

- Developed RESTful APIs using Python (Flask) and designed microservices architectures to support EMR/EHR data processing, insurance validation, and real-time eligibility checks.

- Built asynchronous processing pipelines using Celery and Redis for handling high-volume medical data ingestion and background job execution.

- Designed responsive frontend applications using Vue.js and TypeScript, enabling providers to monitor patient data, claims status, and operational workflows.

- Implemented data pipelines and analytics solutions for tracking patient outcomes, claim trends, and operational KPIs, integrating with Snowflake for enterprise reporting.

- Deployed containerized applications on AWS EKS using Docker and Terraform, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.

- Introduced AI-assisted document processing and NLP-based summarization to extract insights from clinical notes and claims data.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Designed and developed scalable microservices and event-driven systems using Python (FastAPI, Flask), enabling secure and high-performance communication across distributed enterprise applications.

- Built real-time data streaming and ETL pipelines using Apache Kafka, Airflow, and AWS Glue, supporting large-scale data processing and analytics workflows.

- Deployed cloud-native infrastructure on AWS using Terraform and AWS CDK, provisioning EKS clusters, VPCs, and secure networking environments.

- Containerized applications using Docker and orchestrated deployments on Kubernetes, enabling autoscaling and zero-downtime releases.

- Developed RESTful and GraphQL APIs with OAuth2 and JWT-based authentication, ensuring secure integrations across services.

- Optimized databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) through indexing, partitioning, and query tuning for improved performance.

- Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitHub Actions, along with monitoring solutions using Prometheus, Grafana, and CloudWatch.
